example: Te pongo un body limpio.
exampleTranslation: I'll put a clean bodysuit on you.

example: Esta remera ya te queda chica.
exampleTranslation: This T-shirt is too small for you now.

example: Levanta la pierna para el pantalón.
exampleTranslation: Lift your leg for the trousers.

example: Ponte el pijama, que ya es tarde.
exampleTranslation: Put your pyjamas on, it's late.

example: ¡Qué lindo vestido tienes hoy!
exampleTranslation: What a pretty dress you've got on today!

example: Con este calor, mejor el short.
exampleTranslation: In this heat, shorts are better.

example: Ponte la malla para la pileta.
exampleTranslation: Put your swimsuit on for the pool.

example: Te pongo el enterito de ositos para dormir.
exampleTranslation: I'll put you in the teddy-bear sleepsuit for bed.

example: Este jardinero tiene botones difíciles.
exampleTranslation: These dungarees have tricky buttons.

example: ¡Cómo gira tu pollera cuando bailas!
exampleTranslation: Look how your skirt twirls when you dance!

example: Ponte la calza debajo del vestido.
exampleTranslation: Put your leggings on under your dress.

example: Hoy te pongo camisa, que vamos al cumple de la abuela.
exampleTranslation: You're wearing a shirt today, we're going to Grandma's birthday.

example: Ponte la gorra, que el sol está fuerte.
exampleTranslation: Put your cap on, the sun's really strong.

example: Hace frío, ponte la campera.
exampleTranslation: It's cold, put your jacket on.

example: Sin gorro no salimos.
exampleTranslation: We're not going out without a hat.

example: La bufanda te tapa el cuello.
exampleTranslation: The scarf keeps your neck covered.

example: ¿Dónde dejaste los guantes?
exampleTranslation: Where did you leave your gloves?

example: Te saco el buzo, hace calor.
exampleTranslation: I'll take your sweatshirt off, it's warm.

example: Llueve, así que ponte el piloto.
exampleTranslation: It's raining, so put your raincoat on.

example: El pulóver de lana te pica, ¿no?
exampleTranslation: The wool jumper's itchy, isn't it?

example: El polar debajo de la campera, y listo.
exampleTranslation: The fleece under your jacket, and you're done.

example: ¿Otra vez te sacaste las medias?
exampleTranslation: Did you take your socks off again?

example: Primero las medias, después las zapatillas.
exampleTranslation: Socks first, then trainers.

example: Las botas de lluvia, que hay charcos.
exampleTranslation: Rain boots, there are puddles.

example: Hace calor, hoy salimos con ojotas.
exampleTranslation: It's hot, we're going out in flip-flops today.

example: ¿Dónde están tus pantuflas? El piso está frío.
exampleTranslation: Where are your slippers? The floor is cold.

example: Estos zapatos son para la fiesta.
exampleTranslation: These shoes are for the party.

example: Tus sandalias nuevas, para ir a la plaza.
exampleTranslation: Your new sandals, for going to the park.

example: La abuela te tejió estos escarpines.
exampleTranslation: Grandma knitted you these booties.
